==Original Dream Journal Entry That Inspired The Episode== 
I induced lucidity via sleep paralysis. I saw a bread line of poor elves by the colosseum. (This dream takes place in the same continuity of lucid dreams that started on 06/11/2025 and has continued to the present. These dreams take place in the Elven Village that resembles huts of wood and white stone, as well as castles, and is located in a forest of tall pine trees.) I worked alongside an elven chef to create a new kind of super food for the less fortunate. Together we created a miracle berry drink that contains all of the protein and vitamins needed for a day. (The main ingredients are honey, miracle berry jam, milk, protein powder, and a complete vitamin.)
